new.s: What share of the members of the Lokpal must be judicial members?
new.x: Under the 2013 Act, 50% of Lokpal members must be judicial members.

new.s: Under the Whistle Blowers Protection Act, 2014, what is the punishment for revealing the identity of a complainant?
new.x: Revealing identity is punishable with up to 3 years and ₹50,000; a false complaint with up to 2 years and ₹30,000.
